title: Jingle Bells (chorus)
_about: PROPOSED for owner review. Chorus only, from the 1857 tune as sung today (checked against an ABC transcription). Melody in the upper octave (C6 up to G6, real recordings); bass on the lower octave. One beat = a quarter note.

_arrangements: Mi2 and Fa2 sit on two phones and take turns ('alternate'), so the runs of repeated notes, including the eighth notes, are shared between two players. 2 phones: melody only. 3 and 4 phones add a bass note on the first beat of each bar (C, F, D, G chords), all on one phone.
